text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours while the Fear & Greed index sits at 29, suggesting cautious sentiment despite the small declines being within normal noise. BTC dominance holding at 56.3% indicates the market is not rotating sharply away from the majors, though the relatively light $50B daily volume hints at thin conviction either direction. Altcoins show mixed signals—BNB outperforming slightly while SOL lags—pointing to selective positioning rather than broad risk appetite.
